pricing.title: Start with 30 days, on the plan that fits.
pricing.description: Starter, Growth and Scale open with a $299 start fee, then 30 days. That fee is credited to the first invoice if you continue. Custom is quoted. The style studio is included in every plan. A Twilio connection is priced on its own. Your own domain is included on Scale.

billing.intro: What this plan includes, and the card that opens the trial.
billing.includedNote: Seats and open loans are a standing cap. Emails and letters reset on the 1st. Past the included amount, that channel pauses until you add a seat or a pack. Texts and calling minutes also pause here. Twilio credits are not sold on this invoice.
billing.twilioNote: The Twilio connection is separate from Twilio credits. MortgageProx does not sell message or minute credits. Twilio bills those on the brokerage's own Twilio account. When the included texts or minutes here are used, sending pauses in this workspace until the 1st.
billing.seatNote: {{included}} seats come with this plan. Each extra seat is {{price}} per month. You have {{extra}} extra. An extra seat stays on the invoice until you remove it, even if it is empty.
billing.thenTwilio: then it pauses. Twilio bills the credits
billing.campaignNote: Scale and Custom include 800 contacts. Each extra 100 is {{price}} a month until you remove the pack. The platform holds {{ceiling}} contacts in total until capacity is raised.

market.lead: Turn on what this plan already includes. A module from a higher plan moves the whole office up.

tasks.lead: Move work across the board and assign it to the team. A date and time emails that person. Urgent writes an hour before and again at the time. High writes at 9:00 on the due day. Normal writes at 9:00 the day before. Low stays on the card. The daily check can land up to a day later. Times you pick are your own. The 9:00 notes are Central.

hint.urgent: Emails the assignee an hour before, and again at the time.
hint.high: Emails the assignee at 9:00 Central on the due day.
hint.normal: Emails the assignee at 9:00 Central the day before.
hint.low: No email. The date stays on the card.
